definitions.explanation: The artificial supply of water to land or crops to assist in growing, especially in areas with insufficient rainfall.

examples.japanese: {灌漑|かんがい}{設備|せつび}を{整備|せいび}する。
{乾燥|かんそう}{地帯|ちたい}では{灌漑|かんがい}が{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Irrigation is indispensable in arid regions.

examples.japanese: {灌漑|かんがい}{用水路|ようすいろ}を{掘|ほ}る。

notes:
COMPOSITION: {灌|かん} (pour, water) + {漑|がい} (irrigate). Both characters relate to water supply for agriculture.

NOTE ON KANJI: The characters {灌|かん} and {漑|がい} are rarely used outside this compound. Sometimes written as {潅漑|かんがい} (with simplified {潅|かん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{灌漑|かんがい}{設備|せつび} (irrigation facilities)
・{灌漑|かんがい}{用水|ようすい} (irrigation water)
・{灌漑|かんがい}{用水路|ようすいろ} (irrigation canal)
・{灌漑|かんがい}{農業|のうぎょう} (irrigated agriculture)
・{灌漑|かんがい}システム (irrigation system)

HISTORICAL CONTEXT: Japan has a long history of irrigation systems for rice cultivation, including {用水路|ようすいろ} (irrigation canals) and {溜|た}め{池|いけ} (irrigation ponds).

RELATED TERMS:
・{用水|ようすい} (irrigation water)
・{水田|すいでん} (paddy field)
・{農業|のうぎょう}{用水|ようすい} (agricultural water)
・{排水|はいすい} (drainage - opposite process)
・{水利|すいり} (water utilization)
